newsitem.title: USA: House Republicans ask Clinton for new budget.
newsitem.headline: House Republicans ask Clinton for new budget.

text.p: House Republican leaders said Tuesday the full House is expected to vote Wednesday on a resolution asking President Clinton to resubmit his budget by April 7 with changes that would produce a balanced budget by 2002 without relying on automatic spending cuts or tax rises.

The resolution would direct the administration to produce a balanced budget as estimated by the Congressional Budget Office. It would require most savings be in the first three years and would include changes in the Medicare program to ensure its solvency. The White House has insisted its budget does balance by 2002 and has said no revision will be offered.
